Marie Manning was an American newspaper columnist and novelist in the early 20th century.
items.body: She wrote the first newspaper advice column, Dear Beatrice Fairfax, in 1898, the precursor to modern versions such as Dear Abby and Ann Landers. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: The Dawning of the Day is an American romantic novel written by Elisabeth Ogilvie and first published in 1954.
items.body: The novel is the second Ogilvie's Bennett Island Family series of novels and forms the first part of her "Lover's Trilogy." One of those things you can't un-know.
